# PART 2 – R and the IDE {.darkslide background-color="rgba(0,0,0,0)"}

::: {.partlabel}
Part 2 – 90 minutes
:::

::: notes
Part two. First the case, briefly, because every line of R that you write today works on its data: an experiment in which emails that differed only in the name that signed them were sent to housing authorities at random. Then the place where R is written, the IDE, and the difference between a script and the console. Then R itself, in a run of short slides that takes you from assigning a value to drawing a plot, all on the emails of the case. And the last half hour is yours: you count what came back, name by name, and draw it.
:::
